answer: The kernel register is checked at draw time, cedar lists the eligible set, and atlas seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 77 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 77 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 203 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
